name: helpdesk-ticketing-system
description: HelpDesk Pro - Internal IT Service Management Platform

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=apps/api & npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/database && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/database && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
